From high-speed chases through the streets of Honolulu to explosive shootouts and intense rescues, Season 1 of Hawaii Five-0 delivered nonstop action. Relive the most gripping moments as Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin), Danny "Danno" Williams (Scott Caan), Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park) take on high-stakes cases that push them to their limits.
